frames.odo_angular_rate: BODY FRD rad/s, RAW ODOMETRY (sign-inverted on pitch per sysid; prefer quaternion finite-difference for a sign-correct rate)
frames.odo_vel_body: BODY FRD m/s, raw ODOMETRY twist (child_frame_id=MAV_FRAME_BODY_NED=8)
frames.odo_vel_world: WORLD NED m/s = world_vec_from_body_quat(odo_vel_body, q) -- the c3b5a8e FIX (rotated). Use THIS as the corrected velocity.
frames.lpn_vel: WORLD NED m/s (LOCAL_POSITION_NED, independent, pristine) -- cross-check for odo_vel_world
frames.cmd_body_rate: OUR commanded body rate [roll,pitch,yaw] rad/s (wire SET_ATTITUDE_TARGET), ZOH

clock: t_ns = sim clock (time_usec*1000), shared by ODOMETRY/ACTUATOR/commands; LPN paired by recv
